1. Heard learned counsel for the applicant, learned Aga and perused the record.
2.

The applicant seeks enlargement on bail in FIR No.541 of 2023, under Section 323, 363, 376, 504,
506 IPC, Section 3/4 of POCSO Act, Section 3(1)Da, 3(1)Dha, 3(2)5A, 3(2)5 of SC/ST Act and Section 3/5(1) of U.P. Prevention of Unlawful Conversion of Religion Act, P.S. Kheri, District Lakhimpur Kheri.

sentences.text: 3. In terms of the FIR it was alleged that daughter of the informant aged about 17 years was raped by the applicant.
It was stated that when she raised a hue and cry, the applicant was apprehended and he wanted the victim to change her religion.

In the statement under Section 161 Cr.P.C., the victim stated that she was caught by the applicant, however, when she raised the hue and cry, her father Nuruddin vs State Of U.P Thru. Prin. Secy. Home ...

1 came and both of them were taken home and were beaten by the father.
She specifically stated that nothing wrong was done to her.
Before the medical authorities also, she stated that nothing wrong was done to her.
However, in the statement under Section 164 Cr.P.C., the victim stated that the applicant had committed wrong on her and when her father came back, the applicant ran away.
The medical on record does not corroborate any allegations of rape.

Before the trial Court, the victim corroborated the allegations, however in the cross-examination, the victim stated that when the wrong was being committed, she had caught both the hands of the applicant.
She also stated that she did not know the applicant and during the commission of the offence, he had disclosed the name to the victim.
4. Learned AGA has opposed the bail application.

5. Considering the fact that even in the cross-examination the victim stated that the statement given by the victim to the doctor was correct and the fact that the victim statement has already been recorded; the medical does not corroborate the allegation, as such, the applicant who is in custody since 28.11.2023 is entitled to be enlarged on bail.
In view thereof, the application is allowed.

6. Let the applicant Nuruddin be released on bail in aforesaid FIR number on his furnishing a personal bond with two sureties of Rs.20,000/- each to the satisfaction of court concerned with the following conditions:
(a) The applicant shall execute a bond to undertake to attend the hearings;
(b) The applicant shall not commit any offence similar to the offence of which he is accused or suspected of the commission; and (c) The applicant shall not directly or indirectly make any inducement, threat or promise to any person acquainted with the facts of the case so as to dissuade him from disclosing such facts to the Court or to any police officer or tamper with the evidence.
